about: Published launch commands rigtune can seed a calibration with (--seed recipe; rigtune.seed.recipe_for). Each is the engine's or the model's own recipe, quoted flag for flag with where and when it was read. A recipe with `gpus` applies on a GPU whose name contains one of them; the first that applies is used. Nothing here is rigtune's own choice: a recipe is the expert's command, measured first and improved from.

recipes.source: vLLM's recipe recipes/models/thinkingmachines/Inkling-2-Mini.yaml, read 23 Nov 2026 (min_vllm_version 0.35.0, nightly required): --max-model-len 262144 on H100 and DGX Spark; TP1 recommended
